tooltip.connect_hint: Click to open · connect a read-only key to see your portfolio

desktop.keyless: Connect a read-only key to see your portfolio here.
desktop.syncing: Fetching your balances for the first time…
desktop.title: Binance

errors.auth_rejected: Binance rejected the key. It may have been deleted, or your IP isn't on its allow list.
errors.bad_output: The helper sent an unexpected answer.
errors.busy: Another Binance job is running. Retrying.
errors.clipboard_empty: The clipboard is empty. Copy the API key from Binance, then try again.
errors.clock_skew: Your system clock is off. Sync it and try again.
errors.helper_failed: The helper stopped before answering. Restart the plugin; if it keeps happening, check that binance_helper.py is installed.
errors.host_not_allowed: Blocked a request to an unexpected host.
errors.invalid_data_dir: The plugin's data folder can't be used.
errors.invalid_key_format: The clipboard doesn't hold a Binance API key (64 letters and digits).
errors.item_missing: No key is stored. Connect your account again.
errors.keyring_corrupt: The stored key can't be read. Disconnect and connect again.
errors.keyring_locked: The keyring is locked. Click to unlock and retry.
errors.keyring_readback_failed: The keyring didn't keep the key. Try again.
errors.missing_dependency: The Python module cryptography is missing. Install it with: sudo pacman -S python-cryptography
errors.no_secret_service: No keyring service is running. Install and start gnome-keyring or KWallet.
errors.pending_incomplete: Save the API key from your clipboard first.
errors.permissions_too_broad: This key can do more than read. In Binance API Management, leave only "Enable Reading" on.
errors.rate_limited: Binance asked to slow down. Retrying later.
errors.response_too_large: Binance sent an unexpectedly large response.
errors.unsupported_version: Cached data is from a newer version of the plugin.

launcher.empty_hint: Type a coin or pair, e.g. sol or ETHUSDT

move_pct.body_stock: Now {price} (change since the previous day's last quote)
move_pct.title: {symbol} moved {value}

account.bar_mode_body: Right-click the bar widget to switch too.
account.disconnect_note: Removes the keys from your keyring and the cached data. Also delete the key in Binance API Management.
account.existing_body: If you set up a key from the command line before, verify it here instead of making a new one.
account.existing_title: Created a key with the helper?
account.not_verified: Not verified yet: click Verify now
account.privacy_body: Masks balances and quantities in the bar, panel and launcher. Percentages stay visible.
account.recheck_failed: The last check failed {ago}. Data refresh is paused until the key passes again.
account.rotate_tooltip: Replace the key. The current one keeps working until the new one is verified.
account.stocks_permission_note: Binance does not report the Stocks trading permission. Keep it off in API Management.

alerts.empty: No alerts. Use the bell on a pair to add one.
alerts.form_hint: You get a notification when the condition is met, then not again until the wait has passed.
alerts.need_symbol: Add a pair to the watchlist first
alerts.title: Alerts

export.error_no_data: Nothing to export until balances have loaded.
export.tooltip: Save holdings and the return on deposits, with the range picked on Overview, as a CSV in your Downloads folder. Amounts are written even with Hide amounts on.

holdings.copy_link: Click to copy the binance.com link for {asset}
holdings.cost_approx: Approximate: your order history doesn't add up to the shares in your wallet (a split or transfer?). The wallet count is used.
holdings.cost_approx_crypto: Approximate: your trades and deposits don't add up to the wallet amount (Earn rewards, Convert or an airdrop?). The wallet amount is used at the average cost of what the history shows.
holdings.empty: No holdings yet. They appear after the first balance refresh.
holdings.stale_quote_tooltip: Last quote {ago}: the market is closed or Binance returned no quote
holdings.stocks_note: Stock values use the bid/ask midpoint. Dividends and splits are not tracked.

intro.point_keyring: Keys are stored in your system keyring and only sign read requests to Binance.
intro.point_portfolio: Total value, today's change and history across every wallet, including Binance Stocks.
intro.point_readonly: Read-only by design: the plugin refuses any key that can trade, transfer or withdraw.
intro.subtitle: Prices and alerts work right away. Connect a read-only key to add your balances.
intro.title: Your Binance portfolio in the bar

issue.dependency_body: Account data needs it. Install it with: {command}

hint.clock_skew: Turn on time sync: timedatectl set-ntp true

issue.keyring_locked_body: Unlock it and click Retry. Prices keep updating.
issue.no_service_body: Install and start gnome-keyring or KWallet, then click Retry.
issue.rate_limited_public: Prices resume in {left}. Account data is unaffected.

panel.months: Jan Feb Mar Apr May Jun Jul Aug Sep Oct Nov Dec

drift.band_tooltip: Off target means more than {band} points from the target.
drift.crowded: Holding targets in {class} add up to more than its class target.
drift.no_targets: Set class weights in the settings, or target a holding.
drift.plan_empty: Enter an amount to see where it should go.
drift.plan_hint: Buys only. Nothing is sold, and nothing is placed on Binance.
drift.plan_left: {amount} left over: everything you target reaches its target.
drift.plan_none: Everything is at or above its target; split it by your targets.
drift.title: Target allocation

overview.first_sync: Fetching your balances for the first time…
overview.history_empty: The chart starts after the plugin has seen your balances on two different days.
overview.history_grows: History starts {from} and grows each day; longer ranges unlock as it fills.
overview.market_tooltip: Price moves only. Deposits and withdrawals in this range are not netted out yet.
overview.net_none: No deposits found on this account.
overview.net_pending: Return on deposits appears once your deposit history is synced.
overview.net_tooltip: Change in value minus deposits plus withdrawals in this range.
overview.range_outside: That range starts before your history (from {from}).
overview.stocks_at_cost: Stocks are valued at cost until {day}, before the first market price was recorded.
overview.today_partial_tooltip: Some holdings have no opening price yet; stocks get one from the plugin's first quote of a previous day. They are left out of today's change, which stays hidden while they hold most of the value.
overview.today_pending: Today's change appears once opening prices load

unavailable.unpriced_flows: Too many deposits or withdrawals have no price from the time they happened. In EUR, that includes everything before EURUSDT listed in January 2020.

range.bad_order: The start date must be before the end date.

session.tooltip: US market session on Binance Stocks (New York time). Outside the regular session prices move less and quotes can be old.

panel.starting_body: Waiting for the first prices. This takes a few seconds after Noctalia starts.
panel.title: Binance

uncovered.unpriced_flows: deposits with no price at the time

panel.unsupported_body: This panel is older than the plugin's data. Update the plugin.

watch.add_placeholder: Add a pair or a stock, e.g. SOLUSDT or AAPL
watch.empty: Nothing watched yet. Add a pair such as BTCUSDT, or a stock such as AAPL.
watch.notice_stocks_need_account: {symbol} is not a Binance pair. Stock tickers need a connected account.
watch.notice_stocks_unavailable: Couldn't check {symbol} against Binance Stocks right now. Try again shortly.
watch.notice_unknown_symbol: {symbol} is not a Binance pair or stock.
watch.stock_needs_account: Connect your account to see stock prices
watch.title: Watchlist

bar_assets.description: Watchlist pairs or holdings, such as BTC, ETHBTC or NVDA. Price shows the first; Cycle shows the total, today's P&L, then each of these. Without a key, only watchlist pairs have a price.
bar_assets.label: Assets

bar_cycle_seconds.description: How long each view stays before the next one.
bar_cycle_seconds.label: Seconds per view

bar_show.description: Privacy hides the total and P&L amounts; percentages and prices stay visible.
bar_show.label: Show in the bar

daily_summary.description: A notification once a day with your total, today's change and the biggest mover. Needs a connected account. With Hide amounts on it shows percentages only.
daily_summary.label: Daily summary

daily_summary_time.description: Local time as HH:MM, 24-hour. If prices or balances are out of date then, it waits until they refresh, and skips the day if they don't.
daily_summary_time.label: Summary time

day_boundary.description: When "today" begins for today's P&L. Binance uses midnight UTC.
day_boundary.label: Day starts at

desktop_movers.description: The three holdings that moved most today, stablecoins left out.
desktop_movers.label: Show today's top movers

desktop_size.description: Large is 480 px wide, like Noctalia's clock and calendar; Small is 260 px and shows only the total, today's change and the return. A box you draw scales the card evenly.
desktop_size.label: Layout

desktop_sparkline.description: Your total value over the last 7 days.
desktop_sparkline.label: Show the 7-day sparkline

display_currency.description: Currency for totals, holdings and P&L. Past values use that day's EUR rate.
display_currency.label: Display currency

drift_band.description: How far, in percentage points, a class can move from its target before it counts as off target.
drift_band.label: Drift band (%)

drift_notify.description: Send a notification when a class or targeted holding leaves the band. It notifies again only after it has come back well inside.
drift_notify.label: Notify on drift

target_weight.description: Relative weight. The weights don't need to add up to 100: 6, 3 and 1 mean the same as 60, 30 and 10.

targets_enabled.description: Set how you want the portfolio split by asset class, and optionally by single holdings ("20% NVDA") from the Overview. It shows how far each is from its target and where your next deposit should go.
targets_enabled.label: Target allocation

wizard.bar_tip: Then put it in your bar: Settings → Bar → add the Binance widget.

fix.auth_rejected: Binance rejected the key (code {code}). Check it still exists in API Management and, if it is restricted to an IP, that this computer's IP is allowed.
fix.busy: Another key operation is still running. Try again in a moment.
fix.clipboard_empty: The clipboard is empty. Copy the API Key on Binance, then click Save again.
fix.clock_skew: Your system clock is off, so Binance rejects signed requests. Turn on time sync with {command}, then try again.
fix.invalid_key_format: The clipboard doesn't hold an API key (64 letters and digits). Copy the API Key field, not the public key.
fix.item_missing: No key was found in your keyring. Start over from step 1.
fix.keyring_corrupt: The stored key can't be read. Start over to create a new one.
fix.keyring_error: The keyring refused the request. Make sure it is unlocked and try again.
fix.keyring_locked: Your keyring is locked, or its unlock prompt was closed. Unlock it and try again.
fix.keyring_readback_failed: The key didn't stick in the keyring. Start over; if it happens again, check that your keyring is unlocked.
fix.missing_dependency: The helper needs python-cryptography. Install it with: {command}
fix.network_error: Couldn't reach Binance. Check your connection and try again.
fix.no_pending_key: The key pair from step 1 is gone. Start over from step 1.
fix.no_secret_service: No keyring service is running. Install one and log in again: {command} (or use KWallet).
fix.pending_incomplete: Only half of the new key is stored. Start over from step 1.
fix.permissions_after: Then click Verify again. You don't need a new key.
fix.permissions_too_broad: This key can do more than read. Edit it in API Management and untick:
fix.rate_limited: Binance is rate-limiting requests. Try again in {until_time}.
fix.timeout: Binance took too long to answer. Try again.
fix.unsupported_version: This plugin version can't read the stored data. Update the plugin.

wizard.history_body: The clipboard itself was cleared, but Noctalia's clipboard history or cliphist may still hold a copy. Delete that entry.
wizard.history_title: Remove the API key from your clipboard history
wizard.keyring_prompt: Your keyring may ask you to unlock it.
wizard.rotate_subtitle: Your current key keeps working until the new one is verified.
wizard.start_over_tooltip: Generate a new key pair and begin again. Your active key, if any, is not touched.
wizard.step1_body: Creates an Ed25519 key. The private half goes into your system keyring and never leaves this computer. The public half is copied to your clipboard for the next step.
wizard.step1_done: Public key copied to the clipboard.
wizard.step2_open: Open API Management, click Create API and choose Self-generated.
wizard.step2_paste: Paste the public key, including the BEGIN and END lines.
wizard.step2_reading: Leave only Enable Reading ticked. Restricting the key to your IP is fine.
wizard.step3_body: Copy the API Key Binance shows you, then click Save. It goes from the clipboard straight to your keyring, and the clipboard is cleared.
wizard.step4_body: Checks that the key can read and nothing more, then turns on account data.
wizard.subtitle: Four steps. The private key stays in your keyring; Binance only gets the public key.
wizard.title: Connect Binance
